G1.rationale: Postgraduate or undergraduate degree delivering comprehensive education in Design.
evidenceLines: The Design (Honours) program is a 48 UOC (one year equivalent) advanced undergraduate degree for high achieving students. The program is designed for those who have completed an undergraduate degree in Design (or cognate area), and wish to extend their critical and creative skills in Design. The Design (Hons) enables students to advance their knowledge and understanding of design practice by developing a significant practice-led research project. Access to the School of Art & Design’s leading research labs and a selective professional placement program allow students to explore the potential of design in the 21st Century.
